summary: Plan a5-migrate-user-note-003 completed all stages except contract_001, where 39 prior checks passed. The contract stage failed with error "cannot drop function sync_note_customer_note() because other objects depend on it" because the trigger sync_note_trg depended on the function and DROP FUNCTION was called without CASCADE.
revision_notes: Root cause: DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS sync_note_customer_note() was executed without CASCADE while the trigger sync_note_trg depended on it, preventing the function from being dropped and halting the contract stage.

stages.description: Add new column customer_note to account_user table.
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user ADD COLUMN customer_note TEXT NULL;

stages.description: Copy existing note values into customer_note so the new version sees the data immediately.
sql: UPDATE account_user SET customer_note = note WHERE customer_note IS NULL;

stages.description: Create a trigger that keeps note and customer_note in sync during the concurrent period.
sql:
CREATE TRIGGER sync_note_trg
  BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON account_user
  FOR EACH ROW
  EXECUTE FUNCTION sync_note_customer_note();

stages.description: Deploy the new (new-staged) version with a state-only Django migration.
Retire the old version. After this stage only the new version is active.
Remove obsolete note column and cleanup trigger.
sql: DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS sync_note_trg ON account_user;
ALTER TABLE account_user DROP COLUMN note;
